speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a history involving gait and limb ataxia; please tell me, when did these balance and coordination issues first begin, and have they been getting worse over time? Also, do you experience any trouble speaking, swallowing, or controlling your bladder?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like significant ataxia, specifically with a right-sided predominance. Have you noticed any weakness in your arms or legs, and do you experience any numbness or tingling in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) induced by natalizumab. Your history of Crohn's disease and use of natalizumab are major risk factors for this condition. I am requesting a Brain MRI with contrast to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI_With_Contrast
